verdict.rationale: Square's docs confirm a signup entry point ("Switch to Square") and hardware-based in-person payment support (Terminal API, Tap to Pay, hardware take-payments docs), which supports the general path from signup to accepting in-person payments. However, the pack lacks any evidence about the approval process speed, or specifically ordering hardware directly from the merchant dashboard within a defined timeframe. missing for 10: explicit dashboard hardware-ordering flow, approval-time documentation, and any hands-on account of the same-week onboarding experience.
